interactions_time_check.name: interactions_time_check
interactions_time_check.value: "interactions"."ends_at" is null or (julianday("interactions"."ends_at") is not null and julianday("interactions"."starts_at") is not null and julianday("interactions"."ends_at") >= julianday("interactions"."starts_at"))

managed_document_links_target_check.name: managed_document_links_target_check
managed_document_links_target_check.value: ("managed_document_links"."gig_id" is not null and "managed_document_links"."person_id" is null and "managed_document_links"."profile_id" is null) or ("managed_document_links"."gig_id" is null and "managed_document_links"."person_id" is not null and "managed_document_links"."profile_id" is null) or ("managed_document_links"."gig_id" is null and "managed_document_links"."person_id" is null and "managed_document_links"."profile_id" is not null)

managed_document_versions_source_provena.name: managed_document_versions_source_provenance_check
managed_document_versions_source_provena.value: "managed_document_versions"."source_provenance_json" is null or (length("managed_document_versions"."source_provenance_json") between 2 and 4000 and json_valid("managed_document_versions"."source_provenance_json") and json_type("managed_document_versions"."source_provenance_json")='object')

managed_documents_file_path_check.name: managed_documents_file_path_check
managed_documents_file_path_check.value: "managed_documents"."file_path" is null or (instr("managed_documents"."file_path", '/') = 0 and instr("managed_documents"."file_path", '\') = 0 and "managed_documents"."file_path" like '%.md')

scout_position_promotions_resolution_che.name: scout_position_promotions_resolution_check
scout_position_promotions_resolution_che.value:
("scout_position_promotions"."resolution_kind" is null and "scout_position_promotions"."requested_gig_id" is null and "scout_position_promotions"."expected_gig_revision" is null and "scout_position_promotions"."resolution_fingerprint" is null)
    or ("scout_position_promotions"."resolution_kind"='create_new' and "scout_position_promotions"."requested_gig_id" is null and "scout_position_promotions"."expected_gig_revision" is null and length("scout_position_promotions"."resolution_fingerprint")=64 and "scout_position_promotions"."resolution_fingerprint" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*')
    or ("scout_position_promotions"."resolution_kind"='use_existing' and length(trim("scout_position_promotions"."requested_gig_id"))>0 and "scout_position_promotions"."expected_gig_revision">0 and length("scout_position_promotions"."resolution_fingerprint")=64 and "scout_position_promotions"."resolution_fingerprint" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*')

scout_position_promotions_review_check.name: scout_position_promotions_review_check
scout_position_promotions_review_check.value: "scout_position_promotions"."status"='completed' or ("scout_position_promotions"."observation_id" is not null and "scout_position_promotions"."resolution_kind" is not null)

scout_runs_position_backfill_contract_ch.name: scout_runs_position_backfill_contract_check
scout_runs_position_backfill_contract_ch.value: ("scout_runs"."run_type"='full' AND "scout_runs"."source_run_id" IS NULL AND "scout_runs"."operator_reason" IS NULL AND "scout_runs"."request_fingerprint" IS NULL) OR ("scout_runs"."run_type"='legacy_backfill' AND "scout_runs"."source_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "scout_runs"."operator_reason" IS NULL AND "scout_runs"."request_fingerprint" IS NULL) OR ("scout_runs"."run_type"='position_backfill' AND "scout_runs"."source_run_id" IS NULL AND "scout_runs"."operator_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length("scout_runs"."operator_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "scout_runs"."operator_reason"=trim("scout_runs"."operator_reason") AND "scout_runs"."request_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL AND length("scout_runs"."request_fingerprint")=64 AND "scout_runs"."request_fingerprint" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND "scout_runs"."screening_cache_key" IS NOT NULL AND "scout_runs"."candidate_profile_json" IS NOT NULL AND json_valid("scout_runs"."candidate_profile_json") AND "scout_runs"."candidate_profile_version" IS NOT NULL AND "scout_runs"."candidate_profile_artifact_id" IS NOT NULL AND "scout_runs"."candidate_profile_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "scout_runs"."screening_model" IS NOT NULL AND "scout_runs"."screening_provider" IS NOT NULL AND "scout_runs"."screening_model_configuration" IS NOT NULL)
